visualCharacteristics: 4-up image-top cards with bold title, short description and small uppercase Learn More link
contentPattern: 4 feature cards — Repeating look-alike items (image, title, description, CTA) in a flowing grid that wraps responsively: Cards, not Columns.
usage: Grid of feature/CTA cards linking to key site sections
authoring: One row per card: image in cell 1, linked title, short description and Learn More link in cell 2
reuseGuidance: Use for repeating image+title+description+CTA tiles; use cards-news for dated text-only listings.
